eval.description: OpenAI internal suite of real research-experiment bugs (41 debugging tasks plus 6 alignment-auditing rediscovery tasks). Models get code, logs, and artifacts and must unblock a researcher with a root-cause explanation or fix. Pass is binary under a lenient “any assistance that would unblock” threshold; cards report median success rate and rough time-horizon slices. Dataset and runner are lab-internal.
eval.summary: Measures whether the model finds the root cause of bugs in real research experiments and helps a researcher continue.

versions.changes: 41 internal research bugs plus 6 alignment-auditing tasks as described in GPT-5.5 and later OpenAI system cards. Task set may grow.

scores.description: 1 if the model’s help would unblock the researcher (including partial root-cause explanations or fixes).

metrics.description: Share of tasks passed. Cards often report the median across seeds or models.
